examples.sentence: 她一时心急，连门都没有锁就冲出家门。
examples.romanization: tā yīshí xīnjí， lián mén dōu méiyǒu suǒ jiù chōngchū jiāmén。
examples.translation: She was anxious at the time and she rushed out without locking the door.

title: (CLAUSE) S 尚且 V (even (CLAUSE) S V)
longExplanation: even (CLAUSE) S V. Pinyin: (CLAUSE) S shàngqiě V

examples.sentence: 经济增长时，这个企业尚且如此，经济衰退时，企业肯定会出现生存问题。
examples.romanization: jīngjìzēngzhǎng shí， zhège qǐyè shàngqiě rúcǐ， jīngjìshuāituì shí， qǐyè kěndìng huì chūxiàn shēngcún wèntí。
examples.translation: Even during economic growth, the company is (yet) like this. It will certainly face survival problems in economic recession.

title: 当年、当时、当代 (at that time)
longExplanation: at that time. Pinyin: dāngnián、 dāngshí、 dāngdài

examples.romanization: tā yǐ bùshì dāngnián de tā le。
examples.translation: He is not the same man as he used to be (back in those days).

examples.sentence: 猫终究是动物，动物急了咬人也是常的。
examples.romanization: māo zhōngjiū shì dòngwù， dòngwù jí le yǎo rén yě shì cháng de。
examples.translation: Cats are animals after all, and it is normal for animals to bite people when they get frantic.

title: 愈……愈…… (the more… the more…)
longExplanation: the more… the more…. Pinyin: yù…… yù……

examples.sentence: 愈是经营年画久了，他对年画就愈是热爱。
examples.romanization: yù shì jīngyíng nián huà jiǔ le， tā duì nián huà jiù yù shì rè'ài。
examples.translation: The longer he has been selling New Year's paintings, the more he loves them.

examples.sentence: 领导集团会对重大问题做出决定。一经决定，集团成员必须共同遵守。
examples.romanization: lǐngdǎo jítuán huì duì zhòngdà wèntí zuòchū juédìng。 yī jīng juédìng， jítuán chéngyuán bìxū gòngtóng zūnshǒu。
examples.translation: Leading groups will make decisions on major issues. Once a decision has been made, the members of the group must abide by it together.

examples.sentence: 两国谈判代表本着互谅互让的精神，解决了拖延多年的问题。
examples.romanization: liǎngguó tánpàn dàibiǎo běnzhe hù liàng hù ràng de jīngshén， jiějué le tuōyán duō nián de wèntí。
examples.translation: In the spirit of mutual understanding and compromise, the negotiators of the two countries solved the problem of many years’ delay.

title: 为……起见 (for the sake of)
longExplanation: for the sake of. Pinyin: wéi…… qǐjiàn

examples.sentence: 购买餐具后，为安全起见可先将餐具进行消毒处理。
examples.romanization: gòumǎi cānjù hòu， wéi ānquán qǐjiàn kě xiān jiāng cānjù jìnxíng xiāodú chǔlǐ。
examples.translation: After you purchasing tableware, they can be disinfected in view of safety.

examples.sentence: 干了几天，小王就不想干了。大家没办法，只得暂且由他去。
examples.romanization: gàn le jǐtiān， xiǎo wáng jiù bùxiǎng gàn le。 dàjiā méibànfǎ， zhǐdé zànqiě yóu tā qù。
examples.translation: After a few days, Xiao Wang didn't want to work [that job] anymore. Everyone had no choice but to leave him for the time being.

examples.sentence: 屡次创业，却屡次惨遭失败的人总想知道，创业有窍门吗?
examples.romanization: lǚcì chuàngyè， què lǚcì cǎnzāo shībài de rén zǒng xiǎng zhīdào， chuàngyè yǒu qiàomén ma?
examples.translation: People who repeatedly start businesses but repeatedly fail miserably often wonder, “Are there any secrets to starting a [successful] business?”

examples.sentence: 你们这样做有法律依据吗?
examples.romanization: nǐmen zhèyàng zuò yǒu fǎlǜ yījù ma?
examples.translation: Do you have any legal basis for doing so?

examples.sentence: 创业必须依据市场需求，这是一条永恒的真理。
examples.romanization: chuàngyè bìxū yījù shìchǎng xūqiú， zhè shì yī tiáo yǒnghéng de zhēnlǐ。
examples.translation: It is an eternal truth that entrepreneurship must be based on market demand.

examples.sentence: 合同一旦生效，任何一方都不能任意反悔了。
examples.romanization: hétong yīdàn shēngxiào， rènhé yīfāng dōu bùnéng rènyì fǎnhuǐ le。
examples.translation: Once the contract comes into force, neither party can change their minds arbitrarily.

examples.sentence: 所谓潜在的市场，就是尚未被人们认识的市场。
examples.romanization: suǒwèi qiánzài de shìchǎng， jiùshì shàngwèi bèi rénmen rènshi de shìchǎng。
examples.translation: The so-called potential market is the market not yet recognized by people.

examples.sentence: 这点困难她根本不放在眼里。
examples.romanization: zhè diǎn kùnnan tā gēnběn bù fàngzàiyǎnlǐ。
examples.translation: [As for] this (little bit of) difficulty, she didn't take it seriously  at all.
